rules.source: Law on the Protection of Personal Data, Official Gazette of Bosnia and Herzegovina 49/06 (amended 76/11, 89/11 per secondary summaries) — https://www.tuzilastvobih.gov.ba/files/docs/zakoni/zakon_o_zastiti_licnih_podataka_49_06_-_eng.pdf
rules.retrieved_snippet: Art. 1: 'The purpose of this Law is to secure in the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina for every individual … respect for human rights and fundamental freedoms, and in particular the right to privacy with regard to the processing of personal data'; the Law establishes the Agency for Protection of Personal Data in BiH. Art. 2: applies to personal data processed by all public authorities, natural and legal persons.
